statement.text: Let ''f'' be a [[polymatroid function|2-polymatroid function]] on ''S'' that has a [[polymatroid function#Matchings in 2-polymatroids|matroid representation]] <math>M=(S \times \{1,2\},r)</math> with the following property: <math>|C\cap \{(e,1),(e,2)\}| \leq 1</math> for every <math>e \in S</math> and every circuit ''C'' of ''M''. Is it true that <math>\beta(f) \leq \beta^*(f)+1</math>, i.e. the [[polymatroid function#Matchings in 2-polymatroids|minimum cover by matchings]] is at most one more than the [[polymatroid function#Matchings in 2-polymatroids|minimum fractional cover by matchings]]?

status_observation.evidence: pinned EGRES Open MediaWiki revision and categories
